explanations.headline: No. 9’s run pulled a defender away from the ball

claims.text: North London Red’s No. 9 ran over 12 metres without touching the ball, dragging South Coast Blue’s No. 5 away.
This gave a teammate much more space to get the pass and take a shot soon after.

explanations.headline: H9’s run pulled defender A5 away, creating central space for a teammate

claims.text: H9 ran 12.2 metres off the ball, dragging defender A5 who followed the run very closely in the same direction.
As a result, A5 ended up 7.5 metres further from the receiving spot than at the start of the run.
The space around the receiving zone expanded from 34 to 188 square metres, increasing more than fivefold.
Meanwhile, the defending back line dropped 8.6 metres deeper, and H9 never touched the ball before a shot was taken 1.4 seconds after the pass.

explanations.headline: H9's off-ball run created central space for a teammate

claims.text: At 9.4 seconds, H9 ran 12.2 metres off the ball, dragging defender A5 who moved 11.7 metres with a 0.99 directional match, measured at 0.89 detector confidence.
Space in the central lane of the attacking third grew from 34 to 188 square metres—a 5.5 times increase—while A5 moved 7.5 metres further from that spot.
The nearest defender to the receiving zone increased distance from 3.3 to 7.7 metres, while the back line dropped 8.6 metres toward its own goal during the run and pass.
H9 made no touches from the start of the run until 1.4 seconds after the pass was played, when the shot occurred.

explanations.headline: No. 6’s single pass beat six opponents to No. 8

claims.text: North London Red’s No. 6 made a single pass to No. 8 that bypassed six opponents.
No. 8 received the pass that started the attack toward the shot.

explanations.headline: H6's line-breaking pass bypassed six opponents to start the attack

claims.text: H6 played the origin and line-breaking pass to H8 at 4.6 seconds, bypassing six opponents.
No one-two occurred because H8 received the pass without returning it.
The attack included three passes from the origin to the shot, covering 29 metres toward goal.
The chance began 6.2 seconds before the shot and 4.8 seconds before the final pass.

explanations.headline: H6's pass initiates a six-opponent line break and key attack

claims.text: At 4.6 seconds, player H6 from North London Red played the origin and line-breaking pass to H8 with detector confidence 1.0.
This single pass bypassed 6 opponents (A4, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11).
From this origin pass, the attack included 3 passes leading to the shot and gained 29.0 metres progression toward goal.
The chance began 6.2 seconds before the shot and 4.8 seconds before the final pass.
